messages:
lia: Heads-up — planning a dark-launch swap for NA <-> EU routing policy tonight 21:30 UTC. Not a full traffic shift, just 5% to new path for verification. I will be the owner but need operators for smoke checks and rollback readiness.

sam: Ack. I can be on-call for the smoke window. What are the exact checks?

lia: Quick checklist: 1) healthcheck 200/latency under 120ms, 2) prefix KV cache warmup verify, 3) no increase in 5xx from edge, 4) trace spans present for routing tag. Also watch token-level cost spike for oddities.

yun: For healthcheck: run this against canary endpoints:
```bash
curl -sS -D - https://edge-canary.redwood.io/health -o /dev/null
```
Expect HTTP/1.1 200 and header `x-edge-instance` populated.

katie: Who will run the DNS probe and verify TTL honors? I can script a loop if someone shares the authoritative nameserver.

lia: infra-bot: nslookup for redwood-edge.redwood.io on eu-authoritative?

infra-bot: nslookup output: nameserver eu-dns-01.redwood.net -> A records: 52.12.34.56, 52.12.34.57. TTL currently 60s.

sam: I will kick off the smoke checklist 21:30 UTC. Plan: 21:25+ config push rehearsals, 21:30 enact 5% dark launch, 21:35 begin 10-minute smoke. If clear, we hold for 30m then increment. Rollback plan if any error: revert routing policy to previous config and flush caches.

lia: Rollback commands (ops_rohan please confirm):
```text
# rollback route weight via policy API
POST /api/v1/policies/route-weight/rollback
{ "policy_id": "eu-na-dark-launch", "target_weight": 0 }
```
Also `kubectl -n edge scale deployment edge-proxy --replicas=2` if we need to force a warm start.

ops_rohan: Confirmed. I will be near-terminal and can execute rollback. Make sure `deploy-bot` has the canary token unlocked for the window.

deploy-bot: deploy lock status: canary-token unlocked for window 21:20-22:00 UTC by lia. Commands available: `rb-rollback`, `rb-status`.

katie: I'll run the DNS/TTL probe and a small distributed curl from NA/EU regions and paste results here.

yun: Little extra check — monitor KV cache hit ratio via metrics: `edge.cache.prefix.hit_ratio` and alert if < 0.85 during the smoke. Sam, can you keep an eye?

sam: Yep. Will watch the dashboard and alert in #incidents if anything spikes.

lia: Last asks: please react :thumbsup: if you can attend. If you cannot, post backup. We'll start config rehearsal 21:25 UTC.

katie: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

lia: Thanks team — will post final config link and small playbook 10m before.

(automated) deploy-bot: Audit event logged: policy-change-schedule created by lia at 2145678901.
